notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.content: Fixed issues with primary controller input. I was getting feedback that if there was a primary controller that was not a joypad then inputs would not be recognized by a joypad that was not the primary controller. This should be fixed now and the framerate has been capped at 150 FPS as there was a complaint that the framerate was getting up to 400-500FPS at times for some people which was causing high CPU loading.

notes.title: March 2021 Update
notes.content:
Hi Everyone! We've entered the “debugging” stage – and the team has been hard at work testing every little bit of Kung Fu Jesus!

ALSO “Tales of the Red Dragon” – the mini-game we mentioned in previous issues – has been completed :)

https://i.imgur.com/ZIIHmA0.gif

We plan to share more with you soon! Until then, you can reach out to us in the Steam community hub or on Facebook, Twitter, and Instagram!

notes.title: February 2021 Update
notes.content:
Hi Everyone! We’ve been very busy developing Kung Fu Jesus. Craig’s computer “blew up” at one point – and even that didn’t stop us!

What's New?

Ability to change multiple strikes from a single strike while jumping
Tale of the Red Dragon mini-game
The Rainbow Room – where you can replay memories of other characters to unlock more of the story.

https://i.imgur.com/SN5O5ZC.gif

Want to stay in the loop?  Stick around :)

notes.title: December 2020 Update
notes.content:
Hi Everyone! It’s that time of year – and we’re still chugging along with more Kung Fu Jesus updates! We have plenty that we’re thrilled to share with you :)

Here’s the latest:

Implemented a new grapple system; refined AI grappling
Added new animated portals for an extra “trippy” effect
Created a new area: The Sewer

https://i.imgur.com/hiI4pES.gif
Developed a new mini game: Fox Maroon

https://i.imgur.com/UtFkqkj.jpg 

https://i.imgur.com/tgRDbUb.jpg
Designed a new character: Nikola Tesla

We can’t wait to share the other stuff we’ve been working on with you. Stay tuned :)

If you have any questions, let us know!

notes.title: November 2020 Update
notes.content:
Hi Everyone! We hope you’re doing well. It’s been a while since we shared an update about Kung Fu Jesus and we wanted to let you know what we’ve been working on the past month:


Storyline #3 is complete
Grapple system is almost done
4 new unlockable grapple moves:

https://i.imgur.com/ItUvIcy.gif
Judo Throw

https://i.imgur.com/xjpOujF.gif
Suplex

https://i.imgur.com/30ZXigX.gif
Flying Scissor Leg Takedown

https://i.imgur.com/Iw8nUW6.gif
And The Bomb!


New areas: The Naguals Retreat and The Source
New characters
2 new unlockable combos

https://i.imgur.com/KXaBWPk.jpg
And The White Wind (A.K.A. Bruce Lee) has been remodeled!

We will have much more to share soon! Stay tuned :) 

If you have any questions, let us know in the Steam discussions!
